name: meridian
description: A self-classifying engineering portfolio. The site lives in meridian/site and is built from the engine and pipeline beside it.
comment: This manifest exists for one reason: Vercel reads the framework from the
package.json at the Root Directory, and the root had none — so the deploy
failed with 'No Next.js version detected' before it ever reached a build.
The root has to BE the root directory here, because meridian/site depends
on ../engine and ../pipeline through file: links and cannot build without
its siblings present. So the framework is declared here instead, and the
version is pinned to the one meridian/site actually uses. Keep them equal.
Nothing is installed from this file locally: each package installs its own
dependencies, and vercel.json's installCommand does the same on the
builder. It is a declaration, not a dependency tree.

scripts.build: npm --prefix meridian/engine run build && npm --prefix meridian/pipeline run build && npm --prefix meridian/site run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix meridian/engine test && npm --prefix meridian/pipeline test && npm --prefix meridian/site test
